boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named campus places for studying, gathering, recreation, reflection, and connecting with Norwich history.

cards.title: Wise Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus center and dining hub
cards.notes: Use this named campus hub to meet between commitments, find dining options, or start a walk toward the nearby outdoor center.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed campus hub with student services and dining nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich identifies Wise Campus Center on its campus map and lists Wise Dining Hall, The Mill, and Dunkin’ as on-campus student dining options.
cards.access_notes: Campus services and dining availability can vary; consult current university information before visiting.

cards.title: Kreitzberg Library
cards.subtitle: Library and museum access point
cards.notes: Make this a research stop, then enter the Sullivan Museum through the library when it is open for a focused history break.
cards.short_summary: A named library building that also connects to the Sullivan Museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich’s campus map lists Kreitzberg Library, and the university states that the Sullivan Museum is accessible via Kreitzberg Library.
cards.source_title: Sullivan Museum and History Center | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Library access policies and hours are not stated on this source; check the library before planning a visit.

cards.title: Sullivan Museum and History Center
cards.subtitle: 158 Harmon Drive
cards.notes: Browse the rotating exhibits and Norwich artifacts, then use them as a conversation starter or a break from desk work.
cards.short_summary: A free campus museum focused on Norwich history and wider historical themes.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich says the museum presents artifacts and exhibits connected to Norwich, student work, campus events, and broader history; admission is free.
cards.source_title: Sullivan Museum and History Center | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed during university closures and listed holidays. Accessible via Kreitzberg Library or the Bicentennial Stairs entrance.

cards.title: White Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: 158 Harmon Drive
cards.notes: Visit for a scheduled faith service, or ask Campus Ministries about support and transportation to other area houses of worship.
cards.short_summary: A campus worship space that includes Christian services and an Islamic prayer room.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich states that White Memorial Chapel hosts Catholic Mass and nondenominational Christian services and includes an Islamic prayer room.
cards.access_notes: Services and room access may be scheduled; contact Campus Ministries for current arrangements.

cards.title: Shaw Outdoor Center
cards.subtitle: 165 Paine Mountain Drive
cards.notes: Check trail conditions, then choose a hike, run, ride, snowshoe, or disc-golf outing suited to current posted guidance.
cards.short_summary: The gateway to Norwich and Northfield trail networks and outdoor programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich says the Shaw Outdoor Center provides access to more than 1,000 acres of forest and multi-use trails, with hiking, biking, skiing, snowshoeing, running, orienteering, and disc golf.
cards.access_notes: Check the university’s trail-status updates and posted closures before setting out; trail conditions and construction notices change.

cards.title: Plumley Armory
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation facility
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate this recreation landmark, then confirm facility access with Recreation before planning a workout.
cards.short_summary: A named athletics and recreation destination on the Norwich campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich’s campus map lists Plumley Armory, while the university’s recreation page identifies campus fitness and wellness facilities.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and programming can be limited to eligible users; verify current Recreation policies.

cards.title: Goodyear Pool
cards.subtitle: Campus fitness and recreation
cards.notes: Check Recreation’s current pool schedule and eligibility rules before bringing swim gear for a planned exercise or recovery session.
cards.short_summary: A university-identified campus pool within its fitness and recreation offerings.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich lists Goodyear Pool among its destinations for recreation, health, and wellness.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current pool hours, eligibility, and any required policies with Norwich Recreation.

cards.title: Shapiro Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Campus fitness and recreation
cards.notes: Look for current Recreation programming and required orientation details before scheduling a climbing session with friends or a club.
cards.short_summary: A university-listed climbing facility for campus recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich identifies the Shapiro Climbing Wall among its recreation, health, and wellness destinations.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to Recreation’s current access rules, staffing, and safety requirements.

cards.title: Upper Parade Ground
cards.subtitle: Central campus gathering ground
cards.notes: Use the official map to orient yourself around this central named ground, then attend only events that are publicly announced or open to you.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed campus ground used in the university’s new-student orientation schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich’s campus map lists the Upper Parade Ground, and the university’s incoming-student information places Oath Ceremony rehearsal at White Chapel and the Upper Parade Ground.
cards.source_title: Incoming Students and Families | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: This is an event and ceremonial area; follow university instructions and posted access controls.

cards.title: Centennial Stairs
cards.subtitle: Route to the museum entrance
cards.notes: Take the named stair route to reach the Sullivan Museum’s front entrance, pausing to use the museum visit as a campus-history reset.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed campus landmark and one of the museum’s stated access routes.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich’s campus map lists Centennial Stairs, and the university states that the Sullivan Museum is accessible through its front entrance at the Bicentennial Stairs.
cards.source_title: Sullivan Museum and History Center | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Use the route only when conditions permit; museum access follows its posted weekday schedule.
